concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR‑009 (a‑priori power analysis) is not covered by any task in tasks.md. No task implements the required simulation‑based or G*Power power analysis to determine the target sample size (≈600 participants).

The implementation plan references several contract schemas (e.g., stimulus.schema.yaml, response.schema.yaml, analysis_schema.yaml) but there is no task that validates these contracts against the generated artifacts. A dedicated validation task (e.g., ‘Validate contracts against data files’) is missing, leaving contract compliance untested.
